cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

mechanism: Copy a planning signature without reading its different function, then recruit garden protection which becomes withdrawal of the pair's own extension support.
confusable: Not merely changing sides after new facts: A must deny confusion about the copied signature while reinterpreting the recruited campaign.
comparison: Planning signatories opposing their own consent rather than committee attendance being misread as removal.
seedUse: Retains garden versus both-signed extension and renewed recruitment, grounding the signature in mistaken copying.
